name: chanmeng666-profile
description: Data-driven personal profile for Chan Meng. Single source of truth in data/profile/*.yaml; generates README.md, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, and dist/profile.json.

scripts.build: npm run build:brand && node scripts/build.mjs && npm run build:linkedin && npm run build:video-data && npm run build:films-data && npm run build:cv-geo
scripts.build:cv-geo: node cv/build-llms-txt.mjs data/profile --out public/cv-llms.txt && node cv/build-jsonld.mjs data/profile --out public/cv.jsonld
scripts.validate: node scripts/validate.mjs && node scripts/validate-brand.mjs && node scripts/check-linkedin-sync.mjs && node scripts/check-ecosystem.mjs
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run check:freshness && npm run check:cv && npm run check:ats && npm run check:copy && npm run check:x && npm run check:linkedin-register && npm run build && npm run audit
